what: Plan states scoped token adjacency must not false-match and says an adversarial fixture enforces it, but the proposed test list only covers unknown tokens and does not cover valid-token substrings.
scenario_or_breakage: A buggy regex could let ok-checks=monitor_rc_initializer or ok-checks=monitor_rc_init_test suppress monitor_rc_init, while the planned unknown-token fixture still passes because monitor_rc_unknown is not the risky prefix case.
suggested_fix: Add one scoped-suppression fixture in the monitor_rc fixture block using a valid-token substring such as ok-checks=monitor_rc_initializer and assert the relevant monitor_rc diagnostic still fires.
